purpose: Builds tickets through the real ticket builder with planted personal details, compares previewed and posted bytes against an intake, checks nothing is posted without a yes, and checks what the receiver keeps and that a deletion request removes a ticket end to end; fails the send of an approved ticket and checks it is kept, retried with the same ticket id and never changed without another yes; plants values outside each field's set or pattern and checks the field is dropped; and fails, takes offline and delays the intake, and changes a waiting ticket, checking each is kept and sent only as approved.
title: Ticket preview and yes, diagnostics only, receiver privacy and deletion
